subject: Customer briefs: bite-sized extracts for sales deck
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Customer briefs: bite-sized extracts for sales deck

Team —

We're putting together a new one-pager + slide pack for the Q4 sales blitz (targeted at mid-market retail & energy). Ask: please help gather 2–3 short customer-minded snippets per account (1–2 sentences each) that we can use on one-pagers, slides, and in demo intros. Focus on outcome and metrics where possible (savings, latency improvement, time-to-market, ARR impact).

Template (attached): one-line quote, 1–2 metrics (if available), and a 20–30 word context sentence (what they used Redwood for). Deadline: EOD Wednesday (Oct 6) so we can compile and run legal review.

Priority accounts for this round: Luma Retail, GreenGrid, and BrightLayer (if you have recent wins there, include them).

Attachments: snippet-request-template.md (short md template)

If you don't have direct quotes, send suggested copy we can run by the customer. I'll draft outreach once we have internal approvals.

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer briefs: bite-sized extracts for sales deck

Marcus —

Thanks, picking up Luma + GreenGrid. Drafts below (quick, please edit):

Luma Retail — "Redwood cut our end-to-end personalization latency from 420ms to 90ms, increasing add-to-cart conversion by 6.2% in our pilot."
Metrics: 420ms -> 90ms; +6.2% add-to-cart; pilot scope = 12 storefronts.
Context: Luma used Redwood to replace a homegrown inference service for on-the-fly recommendations across peak traffic.

GreenGrid — "Moving forecasting inference to Redwood reduced batch processing time from 3 hours to 25 minutes, enabling hourly grid rebalancing decisions."
Metrics: 3h -> 25m; 4x improvement in decision timeliness; forecast accuracy maintained.
Context: GreenGrid runs probabilistic load forecasts across regional microgrids.

Attached: Luma-snippet-draft.txt (with proposed customer-friendly phrasing). I flagged the Luma quote as 'suggested' — needs approval from Kate before we publish.

—Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood
